t: Masterclass 1, One Must Act, a theory of goal achievement created by Patrick Diamitani.
It works for a single day, a team of agents, or a whole company.
One Must Act says any goal is reached by multiplication.
You start at zero, you build a whole which is one.
Then you multiply it with the right people, agents, and systems,
until the result, measured in reality, reaches 100.
Here's the catch, multiplication only works on a whole.
A fraction short changes every multiplier you add, and the gap widens as you scale.
0.99 times 2 is 1.98, not 2.
So finish the one first.
Every goal has four quantities.
100 the goal. What exactly do you want and by when?
1 the whole. What must exist working end to end?
2 to 99 the multipliers, who carries which share.
And 0 the start, where are you honestly today?
The order matters. Defined from the end.
The goal, the whole, the multipliers, then the start.
Then build from the start. 0 to 1 to your multipliers to 100.
Every step is held to Pat's standard, called FPE.
Finish, always ship complete things, no placeholders.
Process, work from repeatable systems, like skills and checklists.
Effective, judge it by results in reality, not by effort.
Quick recap. Name the 100, finish the one, choose your multipliers.
Then start from 0 today.
Your mission, on one page, write your 100 your 1,
your first two multipliers, and your honest 0.
Remember, one must act.
